description: Use this when the user asks for current job openings with explicit filters (country, keywords, city, number of results). Returns the newest matching vacancies (max 20, paginate with offset) with salary, employer, city, posting date and a link to apply on finder.work or a Finder country site, plus a link to the matching listing page. Do not use for salary statistics (use salary_stats) or for countries not listed in list_countries. Country codes: ru (finder.work, Russia), by, kz, kg, de, fr, be, ch, se, id, at, ar, ec, pa, gb, ie, cz, uz, no, sk, bg, fi, es, pl, sg, nz, mx, co, au, us, cl, pe, cr, gt, ca, nl, it, ro, cy, uy, do, ni, py, hr, si, lv, mt, lu, in, za, ke, hu, ng, ph, gh, ug.

city.description: City where the user wants to work (search filter), as written locally, e.g. 'Минск', 'Алматы', 'Berlin'. Not the user's current location; do not pass coordinates or addresses. Empty = whole country
city.title: City

country.description: Country ISO code: ru (Russia, finder.work), by, kz, kg, de, fr, be, ch, se, id, at, ar, ec, pa, gb, ie, cz, uz, no, sk, bg, fi, es, pl, sg, nz, mx, co, au, us, cl, pe, cr, gt, ca, nl, it, ro, cy, uy, do, ni, py, hr, si, lv, mt, lu, in, za, ke, hu, ng, ph, gh, ug. Call list_countries if unsure.
country.title: Country

query.description: Job title or keywords in any language, e.g. 'бухгалтер', 'python developer'. Empty = newest vacancies
query.title: Query

name: search_vacancies

employment_type.description: Employment type, e.g. full_time, part_time, contract
employment_type.title: Employment Type

excerpt.description: Short description excerpt (up to 200 chars, contacts removed)
excerpt.title: Excerpt

id.description: Finder vacancy id (use with get_vacancy, together with country)
id.title: Id

salary.description: Advertised salary as text, e.g. '2 000–2 500 BYN'
salary.title: Salary

salary_from.description: Lower bound of the advertised salary
salary_from.title: Salary From

salary_period.description: 'month' (Russia) or 'as_advertised' (period as given by the employer)
salary_period.title: Salary Period

salary_to.description: Upper bound of the advertised salary
salary_to.title: Salary To

url.description: Vacancy page on finder.work where the user can read more and apply
url.title: Url

valid_through.description: Date the posting expires, YYYY-MM-DD, when known
valid_through.title: Valid Through

title: Search vacancies
